ko: I LOST ANOTHER KNIFE. DAD IS GOING TO KILL ME.
DAD IS GOING TO MAKE ME PAY FOR THE KNIFE.
THAT KNIFE WAS A FAMILY HEIRLOOM. FROM THE DOLLAR STORE.
MY STILETTO. MY BEAUTIFUL STILETTO.
WHO HAS MY KNIFE? I NEED IT FOR MY SANDWICH.
THIS JACKET WAS REAL LEATHER. ALMOST.
MY JACKET HAS MORE HOLES THAN MY ALIBI.
MY MOHAWK IS FLAT. LIKE MY CAREER.
MY MOHAWK USED A WHOLE CAN OF GLUE. FOR NOTHING.
I HAD SO MUCH HAIR GEL IN. I SLID ACROSS THE STREET.
TELL GRANDPA SID I WENT DOWN SWINGING. I DID NOT.
THE FAMILY BUSINESS IS BANKRUPT.
SID AND SONS IS NOW SID AND SON.
I AM THE DISAPPOINTING SON. THE OTHER ONE IS ALSO DISAPPOINTING.
I WANTED TO BE A DENTIST. DAD SAID KNIVES.
I THREW THE KNIFE. THE KNIFE THREW ME.
WHICH END IS THE POINTY END? THE ONE IN MY BUTT.
I SAT ON MY OWN KNIFE.
THAT IS NOT WHERE THE KNIFE GOES.
MY SAFETY PINS ARE NOT SAFE. THEY ARE IN MY NIPPLES.
I GOT SPIKED BY MY OWN WRISTBAND.
MY STUDDED BELT JUST STUDDED ME.
MY TATTOO SAYS NO FEAR. MY PANTS SAY OTHERWISE.
MY TATTOO WAS SPELLED WRONG ANYWAY.
MY MOM IRONS THIS JACKET. SHE WILL CRY.
DO NOT TELL THE GANG I CRIED FOR MY MOM.
MOMMY.
MY KNUCKLE TATTOOS SAY H-U-G-S AND F-I-S-T.
THE KNIVES WERE RENTALS.
SOMEBODY CHECK UNDER THE DUMPSTER FOR MY KNIVES.
I KEEP ALL MY KNIVES UNDER THE DUMPSTER. NOW I KEEP ME THERE.
THE DUMPSTER IS MY HOME NOW. IT IS WARM.
I GOT KNOCKED INTO THE GUTTER. IT IS MY GUTTER. I PAY RENT.
I SMELL LIKE THE ALLEY. I AM THE ALLEY.
THE ALLEY CATS ARE LAUGHING AT ME.
ONE OF THE ALLEY CATS IS MY DATE. SHE IS LAUGHING TOO.
MY CHAIN BROKE. MY WALLET CHAIN. MY WALLET IS GONE.
THERE WAS NOTHING IN THE WALLET. JUST A PICTURE OF DAD.
DAD LOOKS DISAPPOINTED EVEN IN THE PICTURE.
SID THE THIRD WILL AVENGE ME. HE IS FORTY AND VERY SLOW.
I AM SID THE SECOND. NOBODY REMEMBERS THE SECOND.
I WAS ON MY WAY TO BE A PUNK ROCK STAR.
MY BAND WAS CALLED THE RUSTY BLADES. WE HAD ONE SONG.
THE ONE SONG WAS ABOUT LOSING KNIVES.
I THREW MY LAST KNIFE AT A PIGEON. I MISSED THE PIGEON.
I SPIT IN THE AIR. IT CAME DOWN ON ME.
MY SPIT GOT ME BEFORE YOU DID.
MY SAFETY PIN EARRING FELL INTO MY EAR.
I PIERCED MY OWN FACE BY MISTAKE. AGAIN.
I AM TOO BRUISED TO SNEER.
MY SNEER IS BROKEN. I CAN ONLY SMILE NOW. HORRIBLE.
NOT THE BOOTS. THE BOOTS ARE MY PERSONALITY.
MY PANTS ARE SO TIGHT I CANNOT FALL DOWN PROPERLY.
MY PANTS RIPPED. I WAS NOT WEARING ANY UNDERWEAR. PUNK.
THAT IS MY BAD KNEE. ALL MY KNEES ARE BAD.
I HAVE BEEN STABBED BY MY OWN BROTHER. AGAIN. HE THREW IT.
MY BROTHER THROWS LIKE A LOBSTER.
TELL MY PAROLE OFFICER I WAS AT CHURCH.
I AM GOING BACK TO JUVIE. THE FOOD WAS BETTER.
IN JUVIE THEY CALLED ME BUTTERKNIFE.
I NEVER LEARNED TO CATCH. ONLY TO THROW.
I THREW AND THREW AND THREW. NOW I THROW UP.
SOMEBODY GRAB MY KNIFE BEFORE A KID FINDS IT.
I LANDED IN SOMETHING WET. IT IS NOT RAIN.
I AM LYING IN A PUDDLE OF MY OWN CREDIBILITY.
I PUT MY CIGARETTE OUT ON MY OWN TONGUE.
MY LEATHER IS PLEATHER. MY LIFE IS A LIE.
I WANT MY MOHAWK BACK. I WANT MY MOM BACK.
THE STREETS ARE MEAN. THE FAMILY IS MEANER.
I TOOK A WRONG TURN AT THE PAWN SHOP.
I PAWNED MY KNIVES FOR SNACKS. THE SNACKS WERE STALE.
MY SWITCHBLADE IS STUCK. MY SWITCH IS STUCK.
IT CLICKED. IT DID NOT FLIP OUT. I DID.
THE FLICK OF THE WRIST IS ALL WRIST AND NO FLICK.
I FLICKED THE KNIFE. THE KNIFE FLICKED BACK.
WE ARE A FAMILY OF THROWERS. AND LOSERS.
THE KNIFE SHOW AT THE MALL WILL BE CANCELLED.
I WAS GOING TO JUGGLE AT THE KNIFE SHOW.
I CAN STILL JUGGLE. TWO BRUISES AND A TOOTH.
I SWALLOWED MY TONGUE RING.
THE TONGUE RING WILL COME OUT EVENTUALLY. ONE WAY OR ANOTHER.
MY EYELINER IS RUNNING. IT IS NOT TEARS. IT IS SWEAT.
IT IS TEARS.
SID JUNIOR DOWN. REPEAT. JUNIOR IS DOWN.
DAD SAYS REAL MEN DO NOT FALL. DAD FALLS ALL THE TIME.
I CAN SEE DAD FROM HERE. HE IS SHAKING HIS HEAD.
I PEED IN MY LEATHERS. LEATHER DOES NOT BREATHE.
MY STEEL TOES HAVE NO STEEL. THEY HAVE TOES.
THE ANARCHY SIGN ON MY JACKET IS UPSIDE DOWN. LIKE ME.
ANARCHY IS EXHAUSTING.
NO KNIVES. NO TEETH. NO RIDE HOME.
I AM TOO OLD FOR THIS. I AM NINETEEN.
MY KNEES SOUND LIKE MY CHAINS.
SOMEONE CALL A TAXI. I CANNOT RIDE MY SKATEBOARD LIKE THIS.
THE COPS WILL FIND ME HERE. GOOD. THEY HAVE BLANKETS.
THAT WAS A CHEAP SHOT. I LOVE CHEAP. I HATE SHOTS.
MY DAD THREW A KNIFE ONCE AND HIT A PLANE. HE STILL TALKS ABOUT IT.
I FELL IN A MANHOLE. THE MANHOLE WAS FULL OF MY OLD KNIVES.
MY SPIKES ARE BENT. MY SPIKES WERE FROM A CRAFT STORE.
spawn: HEADS UP! KNIVES UP! FACES DOWN!
I HAVE TWELVE KNIVES. I HAD THIRTEEN.
DAD SAID DO NOT COME HOME WITHOUT YOUR WALLET.
CATCH THIS! NO, GIVE IT BACK! IT IS MY ONLY ONE!
THE FAMILY BUSINESS IS SHARP OBJECTS.
WHAT ARE YOU LOOKING AT? MY HAIR? IT IS GLUED.
MY MOHAWK IS TALLER THAN YOUR GRANDMA.
THIS ALLEY IS SID TERRITORY. WE PEED ON EVERY WALL.
I AM SID. THEY ARE ALSO SID. WE ARE ALL SID.
SID AND SONS. NO DAUGHTERS. MOM IS VERY TIRED.
FRESH KNIVES! GET YOUR FRESH KNIVES! IN YOUR FACE!
I SHARPENED THESE ON A CURB. THEY ARE CURB SHARP.
I THREW UP BEFORE THIS FIGHT. THAT IS MY RITUAL.
MY TATTOO IS STILL HEALING. PLEASE DO NOT HIT IT.
MOM PACKED ME A LUNCH. IT IS KNIVES.
I HAVE A KNIFE FOR EVERY DAY OF THE WEEK. IT IS TUESDAY.
THIS IS TUESDAY KNIFE. TUESDAY KNIFE IS GROUCHY.
THE DUMPSTER SAYS YOU ARE NEXT.
I GOT KICKED OUT OF THE MALL. NOW I AM KICKING YOU.
NICE SNEAKERS. I WILL TAKE THEM. AFTER.
I SMELL LIKE GASOLINE AND HAIRSPRAY. STAND BACK.
LEATHER JACKET IN JULY. I AM SWEATING. I AM COOL.
WE THROW, YOU DUCK, WE LOSE THE KNIFE. THAT IS THE PLAN.
IF I LOSE THIS KNIFE, DAD TAKES MY ALLOWANCE.
GIVE ME YOUR LUNCH MONEY. I MEAN YOUR DINNER MONEY. I AM HUNGRY.
CHAINS! SPIKES! A SMALL AMOUNT OF CONFIDENCE!
I HAVE BEEN WAITING IN THIS ALLEY FOR SIX HOURS. I NEED THE BATHROOM.
STAND STILL. MY AIM IS BAD BUT MY ATTITUDE IS WORSE.
I DID NOT CHOOSE THE KNIFE LIFE. DAD CHOSE IT.
WELCOME TO THE BAD PART OF TOWN. IT IS ALL BAD PARTS.
THE CITY IS VERY CRIME AND I AM THE CRIME.
I PUNK ROCK AND I PUNK ROLL.
DUCK. OR DO NOT. I WILL PROBABLY MISS.
THIS KNIFE HAS YOUR NAME ON IT. IT IS SPELLED WRONG.
I PRACTICED THROWING AT A DARTBOARD. THE DARTBOARD WON.
MY SAFETY PINS ARE LOADED.
OI. YES, YOU. THE FAMILY. OI.
SPIKY HAIR, SPIKY BELT, SPIKY ATTITUDE, SOFT HEART.
AFTER THIS I AM GETTING A SECOND MOHAWK.
I GOT A NEW KNIFE FOR MY BIRTHDAY. I ALREADY LOST IT.
